★ Direction Request
Outfit: Summer Tracksuit
Show Yukino Bijin
Th-That's true. Ahaha...

Umm... I'm not good at positioning, so maybe that~...?
I wanna get better at grasping the whole picture!

Oh dear, is that so? I'm sorry for makin' you worry.
But I'll be back before curfew, so don't you worry...!

Huh? But... are you sure, really?!
It's gettin' late, I'd hate to be a bother...

I see, efficiency, huh...!
That sounds awful "stylish" and real neat...!
Like this, I'll never become a real "city girl"...!
Wh-Well I never...! You mean... my running?!

No...! Gotta focus right now!
Alright, yaaaah—!

Hmm, mmm... Ah! I-It's my turn, right?!
Umm, as for me... anyway, I wanna get stronger and stronger, and...!

Hahaha! I love that enthusiasm!
Training is essential too, though, so don't slack off on that, okay?

It seemed to place a huge strain on her with questionable benefit...
I told her that a more efficient method that wouldn't harm her body would be better.

Yukino Bijin began running back and forth up a steep mountain slope.
And with massive weights strapped to her ankles, no less...!
A few days after helping that simple, pure-hearted student in town—

...Ready, set: Yukino Bijin-chan—!!
Look over heeeere~~~!!
Yaaaaaaaahhhhh—!!

Through the pitch-black, unlit night forest,
her earnest footsteps echoed aloud...

Was she heading to the track for extra training?
Curfew was approaching, though... Worried, I decided to follow her.
...Guh.
...! W-Well, you see...!
(Still, why is this person helpin' me this much...?)

Well, with so much attention on you, you really gotta back it up with skill, y'know?
No joke, it's gotta be tough. The idol types get bashed so easily...

The reason people only see me as an idol is 'cause I'm still soft!
If my running can't fire everyone up... there's nothin' sparkly about it at all!
I wanna become a sparkling "city girl"!

Oh gosh... I-I'm fine, really!
Back in Morioka, I only ran on dirt, so I gotta get used to turf too...!

Ahaha... It's kinda embarrassing, honestly.
—Whoops, it's almost time to start runnin—whoa!
Eek, Yukino-chan?! Jeez~! Such a klutz~~!
Next up is tire pulling! Well then, excuse me!

Aww, she's so earnest and cute! What a real "pretty girl"~~!
Can't wait for her debut! Hang in there, go get 'em~~!

If that's the case, then by all means!
I've still got a long way to go, but... I'll be in your care!

Amidst all this, Yukino Bijin, having arrived from a cold rural village in Morioka,
seemed to carry immense expectations as the next star Umamusume...

Huh, ah... That's not what I meant...! 
Of course I take practice seriously, it's just, um... that "city girl" thing is...

Yes! I run out of steam in the second half, so I think stamina's my main issue.
I'm gonna try adding swimming training to my routine!
C-City girl...?

She's such a great character~! A bit unrefined, but that's what makes her so charming!
Super likable! Looks like she's really gonna liven up the Twinkle Series.

It ain't gonna be easy... but I won't give up...!
I'm definitely, definitely gonna become a sparkling "city girl"...!
Hawawa...?! Th-Thank ya kindly~~...

—*Pant*, *pant*! Let's do this!
I'm gonna become... a "city girl"...!

Jaja?! You're... the Trainer from the other day?
Wh-What're ya doing here...?!

The one least satisfied with all this was the girl herself.
Finding herself wildly popular before she'd even proven her actual skill...

Hmph, hmph...! Wow, I can really feel this working my thighs!
Feels like I'm gonna have some mighty fine sore muscles tomorrow...!

I went to check out an open practice session for pre-debut students.
Word was that the much-talked-about "big-name rookie" from Morioka would be participating today...

Over the past few years, kicked off by Oguri Cap coming to the URA from Kasamatsu and Inari One from Oi,
"regional Umamusume" had been garnering massive attention.

Yukino Bijin kept running without a single break.
In her powerful stride, I could sense tremendous grit—a sheer, unyielding tenacity...
—*Pant*, *gasp*, *pant*...!

—All right, that wraps things up for today. To finish up, let's have everyone share
the areas for improvement or goals they noticed today, one by one. Starting clockwise—
That night, as I happened to pass by the dorms on an errand...
Phew... All right!
